# apa7

The goal of apa7 is to facilitate writing documents in APA Style (7th
Edition).

## Installation

To install the published version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("apa7")
```

You can install the development version of apa7 with:

``` r

install.packages("apa7", repos = c('https://wjschne.r-universe.dev'))
```

## Tables

The package provides functions to create APA-style tables, including
correlation matrices and regression tables. The tables can be formatted
using the `flextable` package.

``` r

library(apa7)
# Correlation matrix 
apa_cor(trees, star_significant = TRUE)
```

![](reference/figures/README-showcor-1.png)

``` r

# Make regression model, format parameters, and display flextable
lm(Volume ~ Girth + Height, data = trees) |> 
  apa_parameters() |> 
  apa_flextable()
```

![](reference/figures/README-showlm-1.png)

``` r

# Contingency table with chi-square test of independence
d <- mtcars[, c("am", "gear")]
colnames(d) <- c("Transmission", "Gears")
d$Transmission <- factor(d$Transmission, 
                         levels = c(0, 1), 
                         labels = c("Automatic", "Manual"))
apa_chisq(d)
```

![](reference/figures/README-showcontingence-1.png)

## Formatting functions

The package provides functions to format p-values, numbers, and other
statistical results according to APA Style.

``` r

# Format p-values
apa_p(c(0.0007, 0.001, 0.0081, 0.024, 0.454))
#> [1] "<.001" ".001"  ".008"  ".02"   ".45"
```

# Package index

## Create flextables

Convert objects to flextables

- [`apa_flextable()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_flextable.md)
  : Convert data to flextable consistent with APA style
- [`apa_chisq()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_chisq.md)
  : Make contingency table with chi-square test of independence
- [`apa_cor()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_cor.md) :
  APA-formatted correlation table
- [`apa_loadings()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_loadings.md)
  : print loadings
- [`apa_parameters()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_parameters.md)
  : format model parameters in APA style
- [`apa_performance()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_performance.md)
  : format model performance metrics in APA style
- [`apa_performance_comparison()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_performance_comparison.md)
  : format model comparison metrics in APA style

## Style flextables

Alter the look of a flextable previously created

- [`apa_style()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_style.md)
  :

  Style
  [`flextable::flextable`](https://davidgohel.github.io/flextable/reference/flextable.html)
  object according to APA style

- [`pretty_widths()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/pretty_widths.md)
  : Use flextable::dim_pretty to fit column widths

## Variable Formatters

Alter vector variables

- [`align_chr()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/align_chr.md)
  : Align text on center text (default is decimal)
- [`apa_p()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_p.md) :
  p-value in APA format
- [`hanging_indent()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/hanging_indent.md)
  : Return markdown text with hanging indent
- [`num_pad()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/num_pad.md) :
  Pads text on the left or right so that the width is the same for each
  element of the vector
- [`p2stars()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/p2stars.md) :
  Convert p-values to stars
- [`star_balance()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/star_balance.md)
  : Prefix text with figure spaces to balance star text
- [`tagger()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md)
  [`bold_md()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md)
  [`italic_md()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md)
  [`superscript_md()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md)
  [`subscript_md()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md)
  [`header_md()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/tagger.md) :
  Surrounds text with tags unless empty

## Automatic formatting

Customize how column_headers and data are formatted by
apa_style`and`apa_flextable\`

- [`apa7_defaults()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa7_defaults.md)
  : Set defaults for apa7 package
- [`column_format()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/column_format.md)
  : Column format class
- [`column_formats()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/column_formats.md)
  : Create a set of column formats

## Alter data.frame

Change data.frames

- [`apa_format_columns()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_format_columns.md)
  : Format data columns

- [`column_spanner_label()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/column_spanner_label.md)
  : Prepend column spanner labels to data column labels

- [`pivot_wider_name_first()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/pivot_wider_name_first.md)
  :

  A wrapper for tidyr::pivot_wider that creates columns names as
  `name_variable` instead of `variable_name`

### Create Special Columns

Adding specialized columns that are formatted differently by `apa_style`
and `apa_flextable`

- [`add_break_columns()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/add_break_columns.md)
  : Add break columns
- [`add_list_column()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/add_list_column.md)
  : Make a column into a list column
- [`add_star_column()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/add_star_column.md)
  : Adds stars next to a column based on p-values
- [`separate_star_column()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/separate_star_column.md)
  : Add columns that separate significance stars from numbers

## Quarto

Functions for creating apaquarto documents

- [`install_apaquarto()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/install_apaquarto.md)
  : Installs the apaquarto extension.
- [`make_apaquarto()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/make_apaquarto.md)
  : Run shiny app to make a document in APA style via Quarto

## Misc

Other Functions

- [`apa_p_star_note()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/apa_p_star_note.md)
  : Make star notes for p-values

- [`is_numeric_like()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/is_numeric_like.md)
  : Tests if a character vector contains numeric-like values

- [`str_wrap_equal()`](https://wjschne.github.io/apa7/reference/str_wrap_equal.md)
  :

  Like
  [`stringr::str_wrap`](https://stringr.tidyverse.org/reference/str_wrap.html),
  but attempts to create lines of equal width
